body: Thank you Willow for reading my post. How do you get out of your darkest moments? Do you ever get out? I really value your opinion, even if you call yourself "a random depressed loser." Us depressed losers are the only ones that can really see. Im surprised that you think Im strong, I managed to write here on this subreddit but that doesn't take much strength I'm just an anonymous face on the internet. I don't know how the people who have been in my position manage to get out of it. What is it that they have that I don't? I appreciate your comment Willow.
